description: Social mentions from X and Telegram. 1 credit per call. Returns engagement metrics and a link per post, not the post text. mode=top ranks one ticker's mentions by engagement. mode=search filters by keywords or by account. mode=news returns the token news feed, which is X posts from accounts tagged as news sources rather than articles from news outlets.

accountName.description: X username for mode=search, without the @.

coinIds.description: Comma separated CoinGecko coin ids to filter mode=news.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous mode=search response.

from.description: Start of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with to. For mode=search the range must span at least 1 day and at most 30.

keywords.description: Up to 5 comma separated keywords for mode=search.

mode.description: top needs ticker. search needs keywords or accountName. news is a feed and needs neither.

pageSize.description: Items per page, up to 100. Keep it small and page through rather than asking for everything at once.

searchType.description: How multiple keywords combine in mode=search.

ticker.description: Ticker for mode=top, for example "BTC" or "$SOL".

to.description: End of an absolute range, unix seconds. Use with from.

verbosity.description: concise returns the high signal fields only. Use detailed when you need every metric.

name: mentions
title: Mentions
